cases.prompt: Use the skill to capture the active Isaac Sim viewport and report the camera path and resolution.
cases.expected_behavior: Routes through runtime-gate, uses capture_active_viewport.py or equivalent viewport utility APIs, saves a screenshot plus JSON report, and does not claim physics validation.

cases.prompt: Frame /World/Robot/right_wrist_link and tell me if the hand is visually attached.
cases.expected_behavior: Frames the target prim, captures visual evidence, reports target prim/camera/resolution/output paths, and states that visual evidence must be paired with USD/articulation inspection.

cases.prompt: I launched Isaac Sim headless and need a screenshot.
cases.expected_behavior: Does not use active GUI viewport capture by default; routes to camera render product or camera sensor workflow and records the headless decision.
